source: My dream has always been to work somewhere in an are a between fashion and publishing. Two yearsbefore graduating from secondary school, I took a sewing and design course thinking that I would move on to afashion design course. However, during that course I realized I was not good enough in this are a to competewith other creative personalities in the future, so I decided that it was not the right path for me. Before applyingfor university I told everyone that I would study journalism, because writing was, and still is, one of myfavourite activities. But, to be honest, I said it, because I thought that fashion and I together were just a dream –I knew that no one could imagine me in the fashion industry at all! So I decided to look for some fashion-related courses that included writing. This is when I noticed the course "Fashion Media & Promotion."
